question: Where can I find a hospital within 110 kilometers, oriented toward the south of the Coachlight Inn Motel, Oconto Falls, WI?
sql: SELECT poi_name FROM pois AS hospital WHERE hospital.amenity = 'hospital' AND ST_DWithin(hospital.geometry, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Coachlight Inn Motel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Oconto Falls%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%WI%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 110000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Coachlight Inn Motel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Oconto Falls%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%WI%' LIMIT 1 ), hospital.geometry)) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5;
